versions.summary: Avoid blocking ROM chip-erase before full-image writes in the 0xFlash-compatible PaperS3 backend; rely on FLASH_BEGIN/FLASH_DATA range erase like 0xFlash.

Switch PaperS3 official mode to an in-app 0xFlash-compatible ESP ROM flashing backend using Android USB serial directly, with robust USB-JTAG reset/sync and SPI flash parameter setup before full-image writes.
Fix PaperS3 official manual download-mode flow by entering download mode before Android USB permission/open, then rescanning the current ESP32-S3 USB Serial/JTAG port before esptool no_reset sync.
Add M5Stack official PaperS3 manual download-mode flashing profile using esptool --before no_reset, with in-app red LED confirmation before connecting; keep the Ink Box stock reset compatibility fix.
Add selectable stable/Ink Box compatibility flashing profiles; stable mode keeps the PaperS3 0xFlash reset sequence, while compatibility mode uses Ink Box-style esptool parameters for verification.
Force ESP32-S3 USB reset mode and idle DTR/RTS control lines to improve ROM sync on Android USB Serial/JTAG.
Fix Android USB serial tiny reads by staging data through a larger native read buffer.
Return full native/Python esptool bridge errors to the app instead of losing the root cause behind Java stack traces.
Fix Chaquopy bridge conversion for Kotlin ArrayList esptool arguments.
Fix Chaquopy Java class loading for Android USB serial bridge.
Refactored flashing backend to Android Chaquopy/Python with official esptool.py for better stability.
Last Dart handwritten ESP32 flashing backend release; superseded by v0.3.0.
